info.title: Zidni Catalog API
info.description:
Product & category management with role/permission-based access control.

**Authentication** — humans: `POST /auth/login` then `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. 
AI agents: `X-API-Key: zk_...` (or `Authorization: Bearer zk_...`).

**Authorization** — every protected operation lists its required permissions under 
`x-required-permissions`. ADMIN has all permissions; USER is read-only; agents have exactly 
the permissions granted to their key.

**Errors** — all errors share one envelope: `{ statusCode, error, message, details?, path, timestamp, requestId }`.

details.description: Structured details (validation errors, missing ids, conflicting fields, ...)

errors: name must be longer than or equal to 2 characters

changes.description: { before, after } snapshots of the resource

metadata.description: Operation details (link diff, MCP tool, HTTP status and error for failures)

password.description: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit (max 72 bytes, bcrypt limit).

accessToken.description: JWT access token; send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

permissions.description: Least privilege: grant only what the agent needs. API_CLIENTS_MANAGE is never assignable.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry (must be in the future)

keyPrefix.description: Public, non-secret part of the key

apiKey.description: The plaintext key. Returned ONLY in this response; store it securely.
